proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6849 dhūma explicitly gives Kalasha Rumbur thum smoke. This matches the survey aspirated voiceless onset; 6852 *dhūmara instead has an r-extension absent here. Exact survey form tʰūm is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4015 *gandhapūrikā explicitly gives Khowar gamburi and Kalasha gambhuri flower. Survey gambūrī matches this whole compound family, retaining lack of aspiration in Kalasha. The blank Proto-Burushaski node returned by search supplies no competing lexical form. Exact survey form gambūrī is preserved.
